data.heading: Intestines
data.text: The intestines are part of the digestive system of the body.
The intestines help digest the food that you eat. They also help remove the waste material from your body.
The intestines are like a long coiled up tube that fits in your abdomen.
In an adult, the small intestine is 6 meters long while the large intestine is 1 meter long.
The intestines receive food from the stomach and absorb all the nutrients into the bloodstream.
They then transport the waste material to the anus, from where it leaves the body.
